en.headline: Tai Kwun stages FRAMED Halloween night in former prison yard
en.dek: The free event runs Friday and Saturday evenings, inviting visitors in art-inspired costumes to become living artworks among light installations.
body: Tai Kwun is holding FRAMED at Tai Kwun on 30 and 31 October from 7pm to 10pm in the Prison Yard, free of charge.

The organisers said the Halloween theme night combines art, heritage and cocktail culture inside the former prison grounds. Dramatic light installations will be in place, and visitors are invited to arrive in unique, art-inspired costumes to walk through the site as living artworks.
Tai Kwun, at 10 Hollywood Road in Central, said the event is intended as a prelude to the evening’s nightlife. Details are available from the venue.

zh.headline: 大館監獄庭園辦「藝裝萬聖夜」
zh.dek: 免費活動周五六晚七時至十時舉行，歡迎以藝術靈感裝扮的訪客在燈光裝置中成為活的藝術品。
body: 大館將於十月三十及三十一日晚上七時至十時在監獄庭園舉行「藝裝萬聖夜」，免費入場。
主辦方表示，這是結合藝術、古蹟與鵮尾酒文化的萬聖節主題夜，在前監獄場地舉行。現場會有戲劇性燈光裝置，歡迎訪客以獨特的藝術靈感裝扮到場，成為穿梭場地的活藝術品。
位於中環荷李活道十號的大館表示，活動旨在作為晚間夜生活的序幕。詳情可向場地查詢。
